def fit(
    name: str, task: ForecastTask, sampler: Mapping[str, Any], code: str
) -> StoredFit:
    """Fit a model at an origin and return it for the store.

    A fit that raises is returned as failed (`failed`).

    Parameters
    ----------
    name : str
        The model name.
    task : ForecastTask
        The task at the origin (`origin_tasks`).
    sampler : mapping
        `samplers`.
    code : str
        `code_digest`.

    Returns
    -------
    StoredFit
        The forecasts, fit summaries and learnt delay.

    model = build_model(name, sampler)
    meta = _meta(model, task.vintage, fit_key(model, task, code))
    fits: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    learnt: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    start = time.monotonic()
    zones, zone_delays = pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame()
    try:
        forecasts = run_forecasts([model], [task], fits, learnt)
        files = fit_files(model, task, sampler, time.monotonic() - start)
        if name in SAMPLE_FREE:
            zones, zone_delays = walk_zones(build_model(name, sampler), task)
    except Exception as err:
        return failed(meta, err)
    return StoredFit(
        meta,
        forecasts,
        pd.concat(fits, ignore_index=True) if fits else pd.DataFrame(),
        pd.concat(learnt, ignore_index=True) if learnt else pd.DataFrame(),
        files,

def walk_zones(
    model: ForecastModel, task: ForecastTask
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Run a walk on every hub zone of the task's provinces.

    The zone run of the submission, the hub comparison, the zone backtest
    and the docs (`nowcastbaselines.zones.zone_forecast`): each zone from
    its own release snapshots up to the origin (`zone_daily_history`),
    for every hub zone (`zone_codes`), whether or not it has cases.

    Parameters
    ----------
    model : ForecastModel
        A walk (`SAMPLE_FREE`), before it forecasts anything.
    task : ForecastTask
        The task at the origin (`origin_tasks`), with its zone data.

    Returns
    -------
    tuple of pandas.DataFrame
        The final-count zone samples as `run_forecasts` gives them
        (`model`, `kind`, `vintage`, `reference_date`, `horizon`,
        `location`, `target_end_date`, `sample` and `value`), none if
        the task has no zone data, and the delay the walk learnt on the
        zones (`delay_summary`), none if it has none.
    """
    from nowcastbaselines.zones import zone_forecast
    from nowcastutils.snapshots import weekly_counts

    daily = task.zone_daily_history
    if daily is None or not task.zone_codes:
        return pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame()
    counts = weekly_counts(daily, task.vintage)
    samples = zone_forecast(model, task, counts, task.zone_codes, daily)
    ref = pd.Timestamp(task.reference_date)
    weeks = (pd.to_datetime(samples["target_end_date"]) - ref).dt.days // 7
    zones = samples.assign(
        model=model.name,
        kind=task.kind,
        vintage=task.vintage,
        reference_date=task.reference_date.isoformat(),
        horizon=weeks,
    )
    cols = ["model", "kind", "vintage", "reference_date", "horizon"]
    summary = getattr(model, "delay_summary", None)
    return (
        zones[[*cols, *SAMPLE_COLUMNS]],
        pd.DataFrame() if summary is None else summary,
    )

def fit_files(
    model: ForecastModel,
    task: ForecastTask,
    sampler: Mapping[str, Any],
    seconds: float = 0.0,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Return a submission candidate's fit directory, after its forecast.

    The directory `bdbvhub fit --config` would write: the model's
    `write_fit_dir` (samples and `ppc.json`), with `diagnostics.json`
    and `fit.json` (`write_records`). A walk (`SAMPLE_FREE`) writes its
    configuration's records and the copula it joined its draws by
    (`fitting.COPULA_FILE`); `unpack` adds its forecasts. A model that is
    no candidate's (`renewal.FIT_VARIANTS`) has none.

    Parameters
    ----------
    model : ForecastModel
        The model, after it forecast `task`.
    task : ForecastTask
        The task.
    sampler : mapping
        `samplers`.
    seconds : float
        How long the fit took.

    Returns
    -------
    dict
        File name to base64 contents, or empty.
    """
    from bdbvhub.submission.fitting import (
        COPULA_FILE,
        get_config,
        write_records,
    )
    from nowcastrenewal.forecaster import FIT_VARIANTS

    write = getattr(model, "write_fit_dir", None)
    names = [c for c, v in FIT_VARIANTS.items() if v == model.name]
    if model.name in SAMPLE_FREE:
        names = [model.name]
    elif write is None or not names:
        return {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        out = Path(tmp)
        if write is None:
            config = get_config(names[0])
            diag = config.fit(task, sampler.get(model.name, {}), out)
            copula = getattr(model, "copula_fit", None)
            if copula is not None:
                (out / COPULA_FILE).write_text(
                    json.dumps(copula, default=str) + "\n"
                )
        else:
            diag = write(task, out, config_name=names[0])
        write_records(
            get_config(names[0]),
            task,
            sampler.get(model.name, {}),
            out,
            model=model.name,
            diagnostics=diag,
            seconds=seconds,
        )
        return {
            p.name: base64.b64encode(p.read_bytes()).decode()
            for p in sorted(out.iterdir())
            if p.is_file() and p.name != "progress.log"
        }

def unpack(
    store: Path | str,
    keys: Keys,
    model: str,
    origin: str,
    out: Path | str,
) -> tuple[str, StoredFit | None]:
    """Write a stored candidate fit's directory for the submission.

    The fit of the current key is used when stored (same code and data,
    same fit), else, while it is pending, the newest stored fit of the
    model and origin (`_choose`), chosen for each model on its own.
    Writes the fit directory (`write_fit_dir`) and `UNPACKED_FILE`,
    which says which fit it came from (its key and commit, and the
    current key) and at which store commit.

    Parameters
    ----------
    store : pathlib.Path or str
        The store root.
    keys : dict
        `current_keys`.
    model, origin : str
        The fit.
    out : pathlib.Path or str
        The fit directory to write.

    Returns
    -------
    tuple
        `"ok"`, `"missing"` (no fit, or one with no fit directory) or
        `"failed"`, and the stored fit if there is one.
    """
    current = keys[(model, origin)]
    stored, bad = _choose(Path(store), model, origin, current)
    if bad:
        return "failed", read_fit(store_path(store, model, origin, current))
    if stored is None:
        return "missing", None
    if not stored.files:
        return "missing", stored
    target = Path(out)
    write_fit_dir(store, stored, target)
    commit = Path(store) / COMMIT_FILE
    record = {
        "model": model,
        "origin": origin,
        "key": stored.meta["key"],
        "current_key": current,
        "commit": stored.meta["commit"],
        "fitted_at": stored.meta["fitted_at"],
        "store_commit": (
            commit.read_text().strip() if commit.exists() else None
        ),
    }
    (target / UNPACKED_FILE).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=1) + "\n")
    return "ok", stored

def newest_fit(store: Path | str, keys: Keys, model: str) -> StoredFit | None:
    """Return the fit `load` uses at the newest origin that has one.

    At each origin of the model in `keys`, newest first, the fit of the

    the newest good fit of older code (`_choose`). An origin whose

        The fit, with its origin and key in `meta`; None if no origin has
        a good fit.

    origins = sorted((o for m, o in keys if m == model), reverse=True)
    for origin in origins:
        chosen, _ = _choose(Path(store), model, origin, keys[(model, origin)])
        if chosen is not None:
            return chosen
    return None

def load(
    store: Path | str,
    keys: Keys,
    results: Path | str = "results",
    min_horizon: int | None = None,
    max_horizon: int | None = None,
    current_only: bool = False,
) -> list[StoreStatus]:
    """Write the stored fits where the backtest and the docs read them.

    Each pair's fit is `_choose`'s: the current key's, none if it failed,
    and while it is pending the newest good older fit, unless
    `current_only`.

    Every origin goes to `forecasts.csv.gz`, from `min_horizon` to
    `max_horizon`: a stored fit holds the submission's weeks, which start
    earlier and end later.
    Fit summaries go to `backtest-fits.csv`, learnt delays to
    `delay-summary.csv` and the zone fits' final-count zone samples to
    `ZONE_FITS_FILE`. Each file keeps the rows of models not stored.
    What was used is written to `STATUS_FILE`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    store : pathlib.Path or str
        The store root.
    keys : dict
        `current_keys`.
    results : pathlib.Path or str
        The results directory.
    min_horizon, max_horizon : int, optional
        The backtest's weeks (`[forecast]`). None keeps every week.
    current_only : bool
        Load only the current keys' fits: a pending pair loads none.

    Returns
    -------
    list of StoreStatus
        One per (model, origin), newest origin first.
    """
    from nowcastrenewal.forecaster import DELAY_SUMMARY_FILE

    out = Path(results)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    status: list[StoreStatus] = []
    loaded: list[StoredFit] = []
    forecasts: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    zones: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
    low = -(10**6) if min_horizon is None else min_horizon
    high = 10**6 if max_horizon is None else max_horizon
    for (model, origin), key in sorted(keys.items(), key=lambda x: x[0][1])[
        ::-1
    ]:
        chosen, failed = _choose(Path(store), model, origin, key)
        pending = not failed and (chosen is None or chosen.meta["key"] != key)
        if current_only and pending:
            chosen = None
        if chosen is not None:
            # Each fit's forecasts are cut to the backtest's weeks and
            # compacted as read (`compact_forecasts`), as are its zone
            # samples, so the store's samples never sit in memory as text
            # at once.
            forecasts.append(compact_forecasts(chosen.forecasts, low, high))
            zones.append(compact_forecasts(_zone_samples(chosen)))
            loaded.append(
                dataclasses.replace(chosen, forecasts=pd.DataFrame(), files={})
            )
        status.append(
            StoreStatus(
                model,
                origin,
                key,
                None if chosen is None else chosen.meta["key"],
                None if chosen is None else chosen.meta["commit"],
                chosen is not None and chosen.meta["key"] == key,
                failed,
                pending,
            )
        )
    for name, frames in (
        ("forecasts.csv.gz", [stack_forecasts(forecasts)]),
        ("backtest-fits.csv", [f.fits for f in loaded]),
        (DELAY_SUMMARY_FILE, [f.delays for f in loaded]),
        (ZONE_FITS_FILE, [stack_forecasts(zones)]),
    ):
        _merge(out / name, frames)
    (out / STATUS_FILE).write_text(
        json.dumps([vars(s) for s in status], indent=1) + "\n"
    )
    return status

def label_origins(
    origins: pd.DataFrame, status: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Say which stored fit each scored model at each origin came from.

    Adds `fit` (`"current"`, `"pending"`: an older fit standing in for
    one not made yet, or `"failed"`), `fit_key` and `fit_commit` from the
    `load` record. A stored model with no fit loaded at an origin of the
    table, and no row there, is listed with no forecast and why.

    Parameters
    ----------
    origins : pandas.DataFrame
        The release backtest's origins: `origin`, `model`, `status` and
        `reason`, with any count columns.
    status : sequence of mapping
        The `load` record (`STATUS_FILE`).

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        The origins with the fit columns; rows not from the store keep
        them empty.
    """
    out = origins.assign(
        origin=origins["origin"].astype(str),
        fit=None,
        fit_key=None,
        fit_commit=None,
    )
    scored = set(out["origin"])
    added = []
    for s in status:
        origin = str(s["origin"])
        if origin not in scored:
            continue
        label = (
            "current"
            if s.get("current")
            else "failed"
            if s.get("failed")
            else "pending"
        )
        here = (out["model"] == s["model"]) & (out["origin"] == origin)
        if not s.get("used"):
            here &= out["status"] == "no forecast"
        if here.any():
            out.loc[here, ["fit", "fit_key", "fit_commit"]] = [
                label,
                s.get("used"),
                s.get("commit"),
            ]
        elif (
            not s.get("used")
            and not (
                (out["model"] == s["model"]) & (out["origin"] == origin)
            ).any()
        ):
            added.append(
                {
                    "origin": origin,
                    "model": s["model"],
                    "status": "no forecast",
                    "reason": FIT_LABELS[label],
                    "fit": label,
                }
            )
    if added:
        out = pd.concat([out, pd.DataFrame(added)], ignore_index=True)
    counts = [c for c in ("n_reported", "n_complete") if c in out]
    out[counts] = out[counts].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return out.sort_values("origin", kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)

def stored_zone_forecasts(
    store: Path | str,
    results: Path | str,
    daily_zones: pd.DataFrame,
    models: Sequence[str] = SAMPLE_FREE,
    origins: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    min_horizon: int | None = None,
    max_horizon: int | None = None,
) -> ZoneForecasts:
    """Return the stored zone runs as the zone backtest scores them.

    Each origin keeps the zones with cases in its release and the
    backtest's weeks, as `load` keeps them for the provinces, for the
    zone backtest (`nowcastbdbv.zones.score_zones`).

    Parameters
    ----------
    store, results, models, origins
        As for `stored_zones`.
    daily_zones : pandas.DataFrame
        The daily zone table (`load_daily_zones`).
    min_horizon, max_horizon : int, optional
        The backtest's weeks (`[forecast]`). None keeps every week.

    Returns
    -------
    ZoneForecasts
        The runs, samples under each model's name and delays by origin.
    """
    from nowcastutils.snapshots import weekly_counts

    low = -(10**6) if min_horizon is None else min_horizon
    high = 10**6 if max_horizon is None else max_horizon
    runs, samples = [], []
    for model, origin, key in _used(results, models, origins):
        zones = read_zones(zones_path(store, model, origin, key))
        if zones.empty:
            continue
        active = set(weekly_counts(daily_zones, origin)["location"])
        mine = zones.loc[
            zones["location"].astype(str).isin(active)
            & zones["horizon"].between(low, high)
        ]
        runs.append({"origin": origin, "model": model})
        samples.append(
            mine[list(SAMPLE_COLUMNS)]
            .astype({"location": str, "target_end_date": str})
            .assign(key=model, origin=origin)
        )
    delays = stored_zone_delays(store, results, models, origins)
    return ZoneForecasts(
        pd.DataFrame(runs, columns=["origin", "model"]),
        (pd.concat(samples, ignore_index=True) if samples else pd.DataFrame()),
        delays,
    )

def stack_forecasts(frames: Sequence[pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Concatenate forecasts, text columns as categories shared by all.

    `pd.concat` turns categories that differ between frames back into
    text, so each text column is first given every frame's categories.
    The values equal `pd.concat` of the frames.
    """
    frames = [compact_forecasts(f) for f in frames if not f.empty]
    if not frames:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    shared = {}
    for col in TEXT_COLUMNS:
        if all(col in f for f in frames):
            seen = {c for f in frames for c in f[col].cat.categories}
            cats = sorted(seen, key=str)
            shared[col] = pd.CategoricalDtype(cats)
    frames = [f.astype(shared) for f in frames]
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

def command(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    """Run `bdbvhub fit-store plan|fit|load|unpack`.

    `plan` prints the fits to make and writes them as a GitHub Actions
    matrix (`--out`), with every current key (`--keys`) for pruning;
    `--origins` keeps only those origins.
    `fit` fits one model at one origin and writes it to `--store`.
    `load` writes the stored fits into `--results`; with
    `--current-only`, only the current keys' fits.
    `unpack` writes the stored fit of `--model` at `--origin` into the
    fit directory `--out`, for the submission.

    Parameters
    ----------
    args : argparse.Namespace
        The parsed `fit-store` arguments.

    Returns
    -------
    int
        0 on success, 1 if the fit failed or the arguments are wrong.
        `unpack` returns 3 if the store has no fit at the current key
        and 4 if that fit failed.
    """
    sampler = samplers(args.policy)
    if args.action == "fit":
        from nowcastutils.devices import host_devices

        # Before anything starts JAX, so the chains run in parallel.
        chains = sampler.get(args.model, {}).get("num_chains", 1)
        host_devices(int(chains))
    config = load_config(args.config)
    tasks = origin_tasks(
        load_target(args.data),
        load_delays(args.data),
        config,
        load_daily(args.data),
        load_zone_data(args.data),
    )
    models = args.models or stored_models()
    one = args.action in ("fit", "unpack")
    names = [args.model] if one else models
    unknown = sorted(set(names) - set(stored_models()))
    if unknown:
        print(
            f"ERROR: {unknown} not in the stored models {stored_models()}.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 1
    code = {m: code_digest(m) for m in names}
    if args.action == "fit":
        if args.origin not in tasks:
            print(
                f"ERROR: fit needs --origin in {list(tasks)}.",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
        stored = fit(args.model, tasks[args.origin], sampler, code[args.model])
        path = write_fit(args.store, stored)
        print(f"Wrote {path} ({stored.meta['status']}).")
        if stored.meta["status"] != "ok":
            print(f"ERROR: {stored.meta['error']}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        return 0
    if args.action == "unpack":
        if args.origin not in tasks or not args.out:
            print(
                f"ERROR: unpack needs --out and --origin in {list(tasks)}.",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
        keys = current_keys(
            {args.origin: tasks[args.origin]}, names, sampler, code
        )
        state, found = unpack(
            args.store, keys, args.model, args.origin, args.out
        )
        key = keys[(args.model, args.origin)]
        used = "" if found is None else found.meta["key"]
        older = f", older fit {used} used" if used not in ("", key) else ""
        print(f"{args.model} at {args.origin} ({key}): {state}{older}.")
        if state == "failed" and found is not None:
            print(f"ERROR: {found.meta.get('error')}", file=sys.stderr)
        return {"ok": 0, "missing": 3, "failed": 4}[state]
    if args.origins:
        unknown = sorted(set(args.origins) - set(tasks))
        if unknown:
            print(
                f"ERROR: {', '.join(unknown)} not among the origins the "
                f"store fits, {list(tasks)}.",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
        tasks = {o: t for o, t in tasks.items() if o in set(args.origins)}
    keys = current_keys(tasks, models, sampler, code)
    if args.action == "plan":
        to_fit = plan(keys, args.store, args.retry_failed, args.usable)
        for t in to_fit:
            print(f"To fit: {t['model']} at {t['origin']} ({t['key']}).")
        print(f"{len(to_fit)} of {len(keys)} fits to make.")
        if args.out:
            Path(args.out).write_text(json.dumps({"include": to_fit}))
        if args.keys:
            Path(args.keys).write_text(
                json.dumps([f"{m}/{o}/{k}" for (m, o), k in keys.items()])
            )
        return 0
    for s in load(
        args.store,
        keys,
        args.results,
        config.min_horizon,
        config.max_horizon,
        current_only=args.current_only,
    ):
        if s.current:
            state = "current"
        elif s.failed:
            state = "the fit for this code failed, no forecast"
        else:
            state = "pending, not fitted for this code"
            if s.used:
                state += f", older fit {s.used} used"
        print(f"{s.model} at {s.origin}: {state}.")
    return 0

docs.text:
Compare our forecasts with the forecasts submitted to the hub.

fetch_hub_submissions downloads every team's metadata and its sample forecasts for the weekly round (wk inc confirmed cases). Files whose licence allows redistribution (OPEN_LICENCES) are kept gzipped in a committed directory; the rest go to an uncommitted cache. Files from the archived cumulative outbreak size round are skipped.

Our models' forecasts of each hub round are the fit store's: the random walks are stored like the fitted models, with their zone runs (bdbvhub.store.store.stored_zones). stored_forecasts takes them from the backtest forecast files for the same round, and compare-hub puts the fit store's whole fits of the round in their place, as those files hold only the backtest's weeks. The source column says which (real or hub).

score_comparison scores every model on the hub teams' cells only: the rounds, places and weeks any hub team forecast (hub_cells). Our models forecast every place and week of their task, and rounds no team forecast, and those extra cells are not scored. Each cell is scored on the weeks the latest real vintage reports in full, from the vintage serving its round (nowcasteval.nowcast.release_backtest). Hub teams have no modelled delay we can see, so no model is scored on the counts later vintages report. A round is pending until a real vintage later than its matching vintage exists. summarise_comparison gives CRPS relative to a baseline on the weeks both forecast, by round and target, with n beside the hub cells scored, so a model that missed some shows it.

def as_submitted(
    forecasts: pd.DataFrame, hub_ids: Mapping[str, str]
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Mark the hub's copy of our submissions as `submitted`.

    ours = forecasts["model"].isin(list(hub_ids.values())) & (

def split_substituted(
    forecasts: pd.DataFrame, table: pd.DataFrame, mode: str = "apart"
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Relabel the weeks a fallback went out under one of our hub ids.

    Parameters
    ----------
    forecasts : pandas.DataFrame
        Samples with `model` and `reference_date`, our submissions under
        their hub id (`as_submitted`).
    table : pandas.DataFrame
        The ledger's submissions table: `reference_date`, `hub_id`,
        `model` and `substituted` (`true`, `false` or empty).
    mode : str
        `apart` gives a substituted week `substituted_label`; `together`
        leaves every week under its hub id.

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        `forecasts`, with substituted weeks relabelled under `apart`.
        Other teams' forecasts and our main builds are unchanged.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError
        If `mode` is not one of `SUBSTITUTED_MODES`.
    """
    if mode not in SUBSTITUTED_MODES:
        raise ValueError(
            f"substituted must be one of {SUBSTITUTED_MODES}, not {mode!r}"
        )
    if mode == "together" or table.empty:
        return forecasts
    subs = table.loc[table["substituted"].astype(str) == "true"]
    labels = {
        (str(r.reference_date), str(r.hub_id)): substituted_label(
            str(r.hub_id), str(r.model)
        )
        for r in subs.itertuples()
    }
    keys = zip(
        forecasts["reference_date"].astype(str), forecasts["model"], strict=True
    )
    new = [labels.get(k, k[1]) for k in keys]
    return forecasts.assign(model=new)

def fetch_submissions_table(
    dest: Path | str, branch: str = "submission-ledger"
) -> Path | None:
    """Copy the ledger branch's `submissions.csv` to `dest`.

    The submit workflow writes it when it records a round; until then the
    ledger has none, and this says so and returns `None`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    dest : pathlib.Path or str
        Where to write it.
    branch : str
        The ledger branch on `origin`.

    Returns
    -------
    pathlib.Path or None
        `dest`, or `None` if the ledger has no table yet.
    """
    import subprocess

    subprocess.run(["git", "fetch", "-q", "origin", branch], check=False)
    shown = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "show", f"origin/{branch}:submissions.csv"],
        check=False,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if shown.returncode != 0:
        print(f"The {branch} branch has no submissions.csv yet.")
        return None
    text = shown.stdout
    out = Path(dest)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(text)
    return out

def fetch_hub_submissions(  # pragma: no cover - network
    dest: Path | str,
    cache: Path | str,
    ref: str = "main",
    token: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Download every team's metadata and weekly-round forecasts.

    Parameters
    ----------
    dest : pathlib.Path or str
        Committed directory, for metadata and openly licensed files.
    cache : pathlib.Path or str
        Uncommitted directory, for other files.
    ref : str
        Git ref of the hub.
    token : str, optional
        GitHub token. Defaults to `GITHUB_TOKEN` if set.

    Returns
    -------
    dict
        A manifest with the commit, the access date and each kept file,
        also written to `dest/manifest.json`.
    """
    from nowcastbdbv.data.tidy import HUB_REPO, _api, _raw

    token = token or os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")
    keep, other = Path(dest), Path(cache)
    head = _api(f"repos/{HUB_REPO}/commits/{ref}", token)["sha"]
    tree = _api(f"repos/{HUB_REPO}/git/trees/{head}?recursive=1", token)
    paths = [item["path"] for item in tree["tree"] if item["type"] == "blob"]
    licences = {}
    for path in paths:
        parts = path.split("/")
        if parts[0] == "model-metadata" and path.endswith(".yml"):
            text = _raw(head, path, token)
            out = keep / path
            out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            out.write_bytes(text)
            meta = yaml.safe_load(text) or {}
            licences[parts[1].removesuffix(".yml")] = str(
                meta.get("license", "")
            )
    files = []
    for path in paths:
        parts = path.split("/")
        if parts[0] != "model-output" or len(parts) != 3:
            continue
        if not parts[2].endswith(".csv"):
            continue
        content = _raw(head, path, token)
        head_rows = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(content), nrows=5)
        if (
            "target" not in head_rows
            or not (head_rows["target"] == WEEKLY_TARGET).all()
        ):
            continue
        root = submission_dir(licences.get(parts[1], ""), keep, other)
        out = root / f"{path}.gz"
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out.write_bytes(gzip.compress(content, mtime=0))
        files.append({"path": path, "committed": root == keep})
    manifest: dict[str, object] = {
        "repo": HUB_REPO,
        "ref": ref,
        "commit": head,
        "accessed": dt.date.today().isoformat(),
        "files": files,
    }
    keep.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (keep / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
    return manifest

def load_hub_submissions(*roots: Path | str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Read the weekly-round sample forecasts in some directories.

    A file may hold a resubmission with a later `forecast_date`. Only the
    rows of the latest `forecast_date` in each file are read; rows with
    no `forecast_date` count only when no row has one.

    Parameters
    ----------
    *roots : pathlib.Path or str
        Directories holding `model-output/<model>/*.csv` or `*.csv.gz`.
        Missing ones are skipped.

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        Columns `model`, `source` (`hub`), `reference_date`, `location`,
        `target_end_date`, `sample` and `value`.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError
        If a model still has two rows of one round, place, week and
        sample, for example one round in both a `.csv` and a `.csv.gz`.
        This stops the comparison on purpose: which copy to score is not
        known, and dropping the model would hide it.
    """
    frames = []
    for root in roots:
        for path in sorted(Path(root).glob("model-output/*/*.csv*")):
            table = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={"output_type_id": str})
            rows = table.loc[
                (table["target"] == WEEKLY_TARGET)
                & (table["output_type"] == "sample")
            ]
            if rows.empty:
                continue
            if "forecast_date" in rows:
                dates = pd.to_datetime(rows["forecast_date"], errors="coerce")
                if dates.notna().any():
                    rows = rows.loc[dates == dates.max()]
            frames.append(
                pd.DataFrame(
                    {
                        "model": path.parent.name,
                        "source": "hub",
                        "reference_date": rows["reference_date"].astype(str),
                        "location": rows["location"].astype(str),
                        "target_end_date": rows["target_end_date"].astype(str),
                        "sample": pd.to_numeric(rows["output_type_id"]).astype(
                            "int64"
                        ),
                        "value": rows["value"].astype(float),
                    }
                )
            )
    if not frames:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=list(SAMPLE_COLUMNS))
    out = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    keys = ["model", "reference_date", "location", "target_end_date", "sample"]
    twice = out.duplicated(keys)
    if twice.any():
        first = out.loc[twice].iloc[0]
        raise ValueError(
            f"{first['model']} has {int(twice.sum())} repeated sample rows, "
            f"such as round {first['reference_date']}, {first['location']}, "
            f"week {first['target_end_date']}, sample {first['sample']}."
        )
    return out

def stored_forecasts(
    paths: Sequence[Path | str],
    reference_dates: Sequence[str],
    exclude: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Take forecasts for hub rounds from stored forecast files.

    Parameters
    ----------
    paths : sequence of pathlib.Path or str
        Outputs of `run_forecasts`, such as the backtest forecasts.
        Missing files are skipped, and so are the rows of counts as
        reported by a later vintage (`as_of`). A model's round is taken
        from the first file that holds it, so a later file fills only the
        rounds the earlier ones lack.
    reference_dates : sequence of str
        Hub reference dates.
    exclude : sequence of str
        Models not to take, such as those run live.

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        Columns `SAMPLE_COLUMNS`, with `source` the vintage kind.
    """
    frames = []
    taken: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for path in paths:
        try:
            fc = pd.read_csv(path, low_memory=False)
        except (FileNotFoundError, pd.errors.EmptyDataError):
            continue
        fc = fc.loc[
            fc["reference_date"].astype(str).isin(list(reference_dates))
            & ~fc["model"].isin(list(exclude))
            & (fc["kind"] == "real")
            & fc["as_of"].isna()
        ]
        fc = fc.rename(columns={"kind": "source"})[list(SAMPLE_COLUMNS)]
        fc["reference_date"] = fc["reference_date"].astype(str)
        rounds = list(zip(fc["model"], fc["reference_date"], strict=True))
        frames.append(fc.loc[[r not in taken for r in rounds]])
        taken.update(rounds)
    if not frames:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=list(SAMPLE_COLUMNS))
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates()

def zone_truth(
    zones: pd.DataFrame, codes: Sequence[str], target: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return health zone counts by release in the target's layout.

    Parameters
    ----------
    zones : pandas.DataFrame
        Zone counts with `vintage`, `location`, `target_end_date` and
        `total` (`load_health_zones`). A zone and week missing from a
        release has no cases in it.
    codes : sequence of str
        The hub's zone codes (`hub_zones`).
    target : pandas.DataFrame
        The tidy target table. Each real release's weeks set its grid.

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        Columns `kind` (`real`), `vintage`, `location`, `target_end_date`
        and `total`, for every zone and week of each release.
    """
    keys = ["location", "target_end_date"]
    frames = []
    real = target.loc[target["kind"] == "real"]
    for vintage, rows in real.groupby("vintage"):
        grid = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
            [list(codes), sorted(set(rows["target_end_date"]))], names=keys
        )
        have = zones.loc[zones["vintage"] == vintage].set_index(keys)["total"]
        frames.append(
            have.reindex(grid, fill_value=0)
            .rename("total")
            .reset_index()
            .assign(kind="real", vintage=vintage)
        )
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)[
        ["kind", "vintage", *keys, "total"]
    ]

def score_comparison(
    forecasts: pd.DataFrame,
    target: pd.DataFrame,
    delays: pd.DataFrame,
    config: BacktestConfig,
    daily: pd.DataFrame,
    zones: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Score every model on the hub cells the latest real vintage completes.

    Only the cells a hub team forecast (`hub_cells`) are scored, so our
    models are scored on the same rounds, places and weeks as the teams.
    Every model, ours and the hub teams', is scored on its own samples
    by the fair CRPS and energy score, so counts that differ compare.

    Parameters
    ----------
    forecasts : pandas.DataFrame
        Hub and our samples with `SAMPLE_COLUMNS`.
    target, delays : pandas.DataFrame
        Tidy tables with every real vintage.
    config : BacktestConfig
        Settings of the tasks the rounds are scored from.
    daily : pandas.DataFrame
        Daily onsets by release, as for `make_tasks`.
    zones : pandas.DataFrame
        Health zone counts by release in the target's layout
        (`zone_truth`), so zone forecasts are scored too.

    Returns
    -------
    tuple of pandas.DataFrame
        The scores (`ReleaseBacktest.scores` with `reference_date`,
        `source` and `horizon`), the energy scores
        (`ReleaseBacktest.energy` over every model of a round, with
        `reference_date` and `source`), and the pending rounds with
        columns `reference_date`, `vintage` and `models`.
    """
    forecasts = _on_hub_cells(forecasts)
    real = target.loc[target["kind"] == "real"]
    vintages = sorted(set(real["vintage"]))
    rounds, tasks, stored, pending = {}, [], [], []
    for ref, grp in forecasts[list(SAMPLE_COLUMNS)].groupby("reference_date"):
        match = match_vintage(str(ref), vintages)
        if match is None or match >= vintages[-1]:
            pending.append(
                {
                    "reference_date": str(ref),
                    "vintage": match,
                    "models": ", ".join(sorted(set(grp["model"]))),
                }
            )
            continue
        rounds[match] = str(ref)
        rows = real.loc[real["vintage"] == match]
        tasks += make_tasks(rows, delays, config, daily=daily)
        stored.append(grp.assign(vintage=match))
    pending_rounds = pd.DataFrame(
        pending, columns=["reference_date", "vintage", "models"]
    )
    if not tasks:
        return pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame(), pending_rounds
    samples = pd.concat(stored, ignore_index=True)
    result = release_backtest(
        tasks,
        daily,
        pd.concat([target, zones]),
        models=(),
        stored=samples,
        compare=set(samples["model"]),
    )
    sources = samples[["model", "vintage", "source"]].drop_duplicates()
    sources = sources.rename(columns={"vintage": "origin"})
    complete = result.scores.loc[result.scores["target"] == "complete"]
    scores = complete.merge(sources, on=["model", "origin"])
    scores["reference_date"] = scores["origin"].map(rounds)
    scores["horizon"] = (
        pd.to_datetime(scores["target_end_date"])
        - pd.to_datetime(scores["reference_date"])
    ).dt.days // 7
    energy = result.energy.loc[result.energy["target"] == "complete"]
    energy = energy.merge(sources, on=["model", "origin"])
    energy["reference_date"] = energy["origin"].map(rounds)
    return scores.reset_index(drop=True), energy, pending_rounds

        Output of `score_comparison`.
    baseline : str
        Model that CRPS is relative to.

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        Columns `reference_date`, `target`, `model`, `source`, `n`,
        `hub_cells` (the cells the hub teams forecast that are scored, so
        `n` below it is a model that missed some), `crps`, `log_crps`,
        `rel_crps` and `rel_log_crps` (pairwise relative skill,
        `nowcasteval.scoring.pairwise_skill`, scaled to the baseline;
        missing for a model that shares no week with any other),
        `coverage_50`, `coverage_90` and `bias`.
    """
    by = ("reference_date", "target")
    out = summarise_scores(scores, by=(*by, "model", "source"))
    cell = [*by, "truth_vintage", "location", "target_end_date"]
    hub = scores.loc[scores["source"] == "hub", cell].drop_duplicates()
    out = out.merge(
        hub.groupby(list(by)).size().rename("hub_cells").reset_index(),
        on=list(by),
        how="left",
    )
    rel = pairwise_skill(
        scores,
        baseline,
        by=by,
        metrics=("crps", "log_crps"),
        match_on=(*by, "truth_vintage", "location", "target_end_date"),
    ).rename(
        columns={
            "relative_crps": "rel_crps",
            "relative_log_crps": "rel_log_crps",
        }
    )
    out = out.merge(
        rel[[*by, "model", "rel_crps", "rel_log_crps"]],
        on=[*by, "model"],
        how="left",
    )
    cols = [
        *by,
        "model",
        "source",
        "n",
        "hub_cells",
        "crps",
        "log_crps",
        "rel_crps",
        "rel_log_crps",
        "coverage_50",
        "coverage_90",
        "bias",
    ]
    return out[cols].sort_values([*by, "crps"]).reset_index(drop=True)

def trajectory_samples(
    forecasts: pd.DataFrame, teams: pd.DataFrame, n: int
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Keep the draws the forecast explorer shows as trajectories.

    Parameters
    ----------
    forecasts : pandas.DataFrame

    teams : pandas.DataFrame
        Hub team metadata (`load_team_metadata`), with `model` and
        `license`. Only hub teams under `OPEN_LICENCES` keep draws, as
        only their files may be redistributed.
    n : int
        Draws kept per model: its `n` lowest sample ids.

    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        The rows of `forecasts` kept, for our models and the openly
        licensed hub teams.
    """
    open_teams = set(teams.loc[teams["license"].isin(OPEN_LICENCES), "model"])
    keep = forecasts.loc[
        (forecasts["source"] != "hub") | forecasts["model"].isin(open_teams)
    ]
    rank = keep.groupby("model")["sample"].rank(method="dense")
    return keep.loc[rank <= n, list(SAMPLE_COLUMNS)].reset_index(drop=True)

        "source",
        "reference_date",

def bdbv_sensitivity(
    data: str,
    config_path: str = "packages/nowcastbdbv/config/backtest.toml",
    origins: list[str] | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Score both pairings on the BDBV release backtest's origins.

    Each origin but the latest (`origin_tasks`) is forecast for
    the provinces, with the country their sum. Zones are their own
    forecasts and are not paired, so they are not scored here. Truth is
    each week's count in the first release the backtest's truth delay
    after it.

    Parameters
    ----------
    data : str
        The data directory.
    config_path : str
        The backtest config.
    origins : list of str, optional
        Only these origins (a block of a chunked run).

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        `variant_scores` rows of every model, variant, origin and level.
    """
    config = load_config(config_path)
    target, delays = load_target(data), load_delays(data)
    daily = load_daily(data)
    real = target.loc[target["kind"] == "real"]
    vintages = real_vintages(real)
    truth = rolling_truth(real, resolve_truth_delay(config, target))
    tasks = origin_tasks(target, delays, config, daily)
    frames = []
    for origin in vintages[:-1]:
        if origin not in tasks:
            continue
        if origins is not None and origin not in origins:
            continue
        for name in MODELS:
            drawn, _ = variant_forecasts(name, tasks[origin])
            for label, s in drawn.items():
                frames.append(
                    variant_scores(
                        s,
                        truth,
                        study="bdbv",
                        model=name,
                        variant=label,
                        origin=origin,
                    )
                )
    if not frames:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=list(SCORE_COLUMNS))
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

def bdbv_candidates(
    candidates: Sequence[Any],
    data: str,
    config_path: str = "packages/nowcastbdbv/config/backtest.toml",
    origins: list[str] | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Score each candidate copula setting on the BDBV release backtest.

    As `bdbv_sensitivity`, with each origin's draws paired under every
    candidate setting (`RandomWalk.paired_with`). The draws are the
    forecast's own, so only their pairing differs.

    Parameters
    ----------
    candidates : sequence of CopulaSettings
        The settings, `nowcastbaselines.copula.CANDIDATES`.
    data : str
        The data directory.
    config_path : str
        The backtest config.
    origins : list of str, optional
        Only these origins (a block of a chunked run).

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        `variant_scores` rows by candidate (`variant`, its label), with
        the candidate's `rho_provinces` and `fallback` at that origin.
    """
    config = load_config(config_path)
    target, delays = load_target(data), load_delays(data)
    real = target.loc[target["kind"] == "real"]
    truth = rolling_truth(real, resolve_truth_delay(config, target))
    tasks = origin_tasks(target, delays, config, load_daily(data))
    frames = []
    for origin in real_vintages(real)[:-1]:
        if origin not in tasks:
            continue
        if origins is not None and origin not in origins:
            continue
        for name in MODELS:
            model: RandomWalk = dataclasses.replace(
                cast("RandomWalk", get_model(name)), keep_variants=True
            )
            try:
                model.forecast(tasks[origin])
            except ModelUnavailableError:
                continue
            for candidate in candidates:
                drawn, fit = model.paired_with(candidate)
                scores = variant_scores(
                    add_national(drawn),
                    truth,
                    study="bdbv",
                    model=name,
                    variant=candidate.label,
                    origin=origin,
                )
                fit = fit or {"rho_provinces": np.nan, "fallback": False}
                frames.append(
                    scores.assign(
                        rho_provinces=float(cast(float, fit["rho_provinces"])),
                        fallback=bool(fit["fallback"]),
                    )
                )
    if not frames:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=list(CANDIDATE_COLUMNS))
    return pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

docs.text:
The BDBV foundation-model check: Chronos-2 on every hub release, scored.

Each model forecasts every real release of the hub data that has a later one (nowcasteval.nowcast.forecast_releases), alone, into its own folder, so the reference models are made once and a new fine-tuned checkpoint reruns only itself. The Chronos-2 models, zero-shot and fine-tuned alike, build the fine-tuned models' layout: one joint block of the country, every province and the active zones, and one block per province of the province and all its zones (nowcastfoundation.forecaster.active_views, the rule in packages/nowcastfoundation/config/finetune.toml).

The report (bdbvhub.reporting.ftcheck_report) scores the folders together (score_releases) and gives each model's pairwise relative skill (nowcasteval.scoring.pairwise_skill) on the CRPS and the log CRPS, scaled to the reference, overall and by weeks back, with each model's forecasts and rounds; each model's calibration by level and weeks back (calibration: medians against truth and against what was already reported, 90% coverage) and the week-to-week roughness of its medians against the truth's (roughness); the active zones per release; and the forecasts with their 50% and 90% intervals. Only the hub's weekly targets at its locations are scored.

  • release_tasks: the scored tasks of every release.
  • check_model: a model as the check runs it.
  • forecast: one model's forecasts, written to a folder.

def forecast(
    name: str,
    data: Path | str,
    out: Path | str,
    checkpoint: str | None = None,
    config: Path | str = BACKTEST_CONFIG,
) -> ReleaseForecasts:
    """Forecast every release with one model and write its folder.

    Each release's forecasts go to their own folder as they are made
    (`RELEASES`), and a run resumes from those there. Also writes
    `blocks.csv`, the block sizes of a Chronos-2 model at each release
    (`FoundationModel.block_sizes`).

    Parameters
    ----------
    name : str
        A registered model.
    data : pathlib.Path or str
        The tidy hub data.
    out : pathlib.Path or str
        The folder.
    checkpoint : str, optional
        See `check_model`.
    config : pathlib.Path or str
        The backtest config (`release_tasks`).

    Returns
    -------
    ReleaseForecasts
        The forecasts.
    """
    tasks, target, _, _ = release_tasks(data, config)
    model = check_model(name, checkpoint)
    out = Path(out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if isinstance(model, FoundationModel):
        sizes = [
            model.block_sizes(t).assign(origin=t.vintage)
            for t in tasks
            if t.kind == "real"
        ]
        pd.concat(sizes, ignore_index=True).to_csv(
            out / "blocks.csv", index=False
        )
    parts = [
        _release_part(out / RELEASES / t.vintage, t, target, model)
        for t in sorted(tasks, key=lambda t: t.vintage)
    ]
    run = ReleaseForecasts.read(parts)
    run.write(out)
    return run

def relative_crps(
    scores: pd.DataFrame,
    by: Sequence[str] = ("target",),
    baseline: str | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """`nowcast.relative_crps`, with each model lacking cells marked.

    The baseline defaults to the site's (`site_baseline`).

    Each row gets `cells`, the baseline's n in its group, and `partial`
    (`mark_partial`). Full rows all have the baseline's n, and partial
    rows come after them in each group, so the tables never set a model
    scored on fewer forecasts among the others.
    """
    baseline = baseline or site_baseline()
    out = mark_partial(_relative_crps(scores, by, baseline), by, baseline)
    keys = [c for c in by if c in out.columns]
    return out.sort_values([*keys, "partial"], kind="stable").reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    save_light_dark(
        lambda mode: plot_downward_updates(real, zones, mode=mode),
        fig / "downward-updates.svg",
    )
    _write(gen / "downward-updates.md", _downward_table(real, zones))
    save_light_dark(
        lambda mode: plot_delay_distribution(latest_delays, mode=mode),
        fig / "delay-distribution.svg",
    )
    save_light_dark(
        lambda mode: plot_delays_over_time(delays, mode=mode),
        fig / "delays-time.svg",
    )
    summary = real.groupby("vintage").agg(
        cutoff=("cutoff", "first"),
        weeks=("target_end_date", "nunique"),
        first_week=("target_end_date", "min"),
        last_week=("target_end_date", "max"),
    )
    nat = (
        real.loc[real["location"] == NATIONAL]
        .groupby("vintage")[["observed", "imputed", "total"]]
        .sum()
    )
    prov = real.loc[(real["location"] != NATIONAL) & (real["total"] > 0)]
    summary["provinces_with_cases"] = prov.groupby("vintage")[
        "location"
    ].nunique()
    summary = summary.join(nat).reset_index()
    summary.insert(
        2,
        "days_to_release",
        (
            pd.to_datetime(summary["vintage"])
            - pd.to_datetime(summary["cutoff"])
        ).dt.days,
    )
    summary["delay_rows"] = summary["vintage"].map(
        delays.groupby("vintage").size()
    )
    _write(gen / "vintages.md", _table(summary))
    coherence = national_coherence(real)
    by_vintage = (
        coherence.assign(with_gap=coherence["gap"] != 0)
        .pivot_table(
            index="vintage",
            columns="stream",
            values="with_gap",
            aggfunc="sum",
        )[list(COHERENCE_STREAMS)]
        .rename(columns=lambda s: f"{s} weeks with a gap")
        .reset_index()
    )
    _write(gen / "national-coherence.md", _table(by_vintage))
    dsum = delay_summary(latest_delays, by=("location_name",))
    _write(gen / "delays.md", _table(dsum.sort_values("n", ascending=False)))
    new = newly_missing(real)
    new = new.loc[new["location"] == NATIONAL]
    _write(gen / "newly-missing.md", _table(new.drop(columns=["kind"])))

    # Backtest and comparison pages: the models the site shows.
    names = _page_models()
    # The backtests' scores come from the fit store (its backtests job);
    # before it has stored any, their sections say so (`NOT_STORED`).
    stored = (res / "nowcast-scores.csv").exists()
    if stored:
        summaries = _release_section(
            fig, gen, res, real, names, config.score_samples, config.n_samples
        )
        _backtest_page(
            fig, gen, res, out, config, target, names, data_dir, summaries
        )
    _comparison_page(fig, gen, Path(hub_comparison), target)
    germany_page(
        fig,
        gen,
        Path(germany),
        load_germany_config(germany_config),
        site_models,
    )
    if (res / "pairing").is_dir():
        pairing_page(res / "pairing", gen)

    # Nowcast page: latest real vintage, every registered model.
    rows = real.loc[real["vintage"] == latest]
    zone_data = load_zone_data(data_dir)
    tasks = make_tasks(
        rows, delays, config, history=real, daily=daily, zones=zone_data
    )
    forecasts_now = _nowcast_forecasts(tasks, latest, res)
    _nowcast_page(fig, gen, target, forecasts_now, names, config, latest)
    _zone_nowcast_section(
        fig, gen, data_dir, target, tasks[0], forecasts_now, config, names,
        store, res,
    )  # fmt: skip
    # Every model's hub tables at every real origin, for the round
    # releases, so a round released after later hub releases still gets
    # its own.
    zone_fits = res / ZONE_FITS_FILE
    zone_samples = (
        pd.read_csv(zone_fits, dtype={"vintage": str, "target_end_date": str})
        if zone_fits.exists()
        else None
    )
    for vintage in backtest_origins(real, config):
        if vintage == latest:
            task, at = tasks[0], forecasts_now
        else:
            task = make_tasks(
                real.loc[real["vintage"] == vintage],
                delays,
                config,
                history=real,
                daily=daily,
                zones=zone_data,
            )[0]
            at = _stored_at(res, vintage)
        # The walks' zones are their stored zone runs, read one origin
        # at a time.
        walks = stored_zones(store, res, origins=[str(vintage)])
        both = [
            f for f in (zone_samples, walks) if f is not None and not f.empty
        ]
        zone_runs = pd.concat(both, ignore_index=True) if both else None
        write_hub_tables(
            hub_tables(at, task, zone_data.codes, zone_runs),
            res / "hub" / str(vintage),
        )
    groups = _nowcast_groups(target, sorted(set(forecasts_now["location"])))
    save_light_dark(
        partial(
            plot_delay_check, daily, latest, [*groups["main"], *groups["other"]]
        ),
        fig / "delay-check.svg",
    )
    # Written by `fit-store load` from the stored fits.
    learnt = pd.read_csv(res / DELAY_SUMMARY_FILE)
    fitted = sorted(set(learnt["location"]) - {"shared"})
    baseline = baseline_share(
        daily, str(learnt["vintage"].max()), [NATIONAL, *fitted]
    )
    save_light_dark(
        partial(plot_renewal_delay, learnt, baseline, location_names(real)),
        fig / "renewal-delay.svg",
    )
    if not stored:
        _not_stored(gen)

docs.title: How it is used in the workflow
docs.text:
The CI workflows and the Snakemake rules run the package through the bdbvhub command.

  • Fit store downloads the hub's data (bdbvhub data) fits and stores every model (bdbvhub fit-store) and runs the random walk backtests (bdbvhub backtest).
  • Fit candidates unpacks each candidate's stored fit (bdbvhub fit-store unpack) and writes its hub file (bdbvhub nowcast).
  • Submit to the BDBV hub reaches the rest of the repository only through the bdbvhub command.
  • Site loads the stored fits, compares them with the hub's forecasts and builds the hub pages of the docs site (bdbvhub fit-store load, bdbvhub compare-hub, bdbvhub report).

In the workflow, the hub_data, hub_comparison, rt_check, this_round, ft_check_forecast and ft_check_page rules call it, as does ablation_forecast. The paper's workflow reads the hub's releases with bdbvhub data.

How a week's submission runs is on the main site: Submission workflow.
